alt: Farah and Nazari review two detector flags while questioning their shared training data.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 2 are canonical identity authorities in this order: dr-farah, chief-nazari. Reference 3 is the room authority; reference 4 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 2 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Dr. Farah: medium-brown skin, dark tied hair, gray lab coat, earrings and translucent green AR lens over her left eye. Chief Nazari: mature woman, silver-streaked dark bob, weathered tan face and olive engineering coveralls.
Specific action and staging: Farah and Chief Nazari lean near the bridge controls discussing the shared evidence. Farah rests her hand on the keyboard and turns to Nazari with an earnest explanation. Nazari rests one hand on the rail and the other on the console, skeptical but attentive. No pens or pointing gestures. Recompose upside-down table diagram as a large upright shared display, keeping the lively dialogue.
Exact visible display content: Title "Shared capture". One input branches to three boxes "Statistical: quiet", "Autoencoder: flag", "LSTM: flag". The two flagged branches join "Votes: 2" then "Alert: investigate". Footer "Cause unresolved". Separate readable caution "Shared training data can affect multiple votes". No solved cause.
